contracts_checked: The patch changes one comparison in verify_receipt. It removes only ctime_ns from each completed file-identity dictionary before equality comparison.
All remaining fields and unexpected extra dictionary fields still require equality. In particular SHA256, resolved path, device, inode, size_bytes and mtime_ns remain exact.
digest_file remains unchanged: it compares full device/inode/size/mtime/ctime identity before and after reading the same open file, and again at the named path.
verify_receipt still hashes every recorded input on each verification. The existing calls occur before anonymous compilation and after anonymous execution.
Graph identity comparison retains full dictionary equality, including ctime. Exact revision, clean tracked sources, profile and successful-build requirements are unchanged.
Compiler, explicit linker, SDK/resource trees, exported headers and production archive/object files remain in the same receipt set. None is omitted or replaced with timestamp-only verification.
The raw receipt file is still checked for byte equality after execution. This patch neither rewrites receipt history nor alters compile/link commands, output controls or native admission.
